title: Sell Review Management to Local Businesses
summary: Find local businesses with weak reviews, show them drafted replies and sell a monthly review-care plan.

money_potential.label: Medium
money_potential.basis: Assumes a low monthly fee per business, so income builds with client count.
money_potential.note: Money tiers are our estimates (labelled Estimate) of relative earning potential, each with its assumption. They are not promises, income claims or advice. Results depend on your market, offer and effort.

how_it_makes_money: A simple, recurring offer many local owners need.
Drafted replies show value before they pay.

steps: Build a list of 20 businesses with unanswered reviews.
Show three a sample of drafted replies.
Run monthly review care for those who sign.
guardrails: Check local rules on cold outreach, calls and texts before contacting anyone.
Every message and document stays a draft until you approve it.
